newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Electronic Res in S$20.6 mln placement.
newsitem.headline: Electronic Res in S$20.6 mln placement.

text.p: Electronics distributor, Electronic Resources Ltd said on Thursday it aimed to raise Singapore $20.6 million through the placement of 13.37 million ordinary shares on the Stock Exchange of Singapore.
Proceeds from the placement would be used for working capital, the company said in a statement.
The placement, representing about 10 percent of the company's existing issued share capital, would be handled by Fraser Securities Pte Ltd, said the statement.
Electronic Resources said the share subscription price of S$1.55 represented a discount of 2.5 percent over the last transacted price of S$1.59 per share on November 20.
The placement is conditional on approval of the stock exchange authorities, the statement said.
